subject: Vendor invoice intake: minimal skeleton + portal fallback / ACK flow
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@brightline.io>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts@brightline.io
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission question

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the onboarding call this morning. Quick follow-up from our AP team: is Redwood requiring Brightline to submit invoices only through the portal going forward, or is there a supported email fallback for small batches while we finish SSO? Our team currently stamps POs on invoices in our ERP and can include a PO field in the CSV, but we want to align on the acknowledgement (ACK) behavior — does Redwood send an automated receipt when a vendor emails an invoice?

If email fallback is OK, can you confirm the minimal fields Redwood needs so we can export a compact CSV for the next two months while portal access is configured?

Thanks — Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Finance Ops
Brightline Labs

Attachment: portal_onboarding_checklist.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightline.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission question

Hi Elena — great question and thanks for the call this AM. Short answers up front:

- Preferred: portal submission (best ACKs and automation).
- Allowed: vendor email fallback for up to 90 days during SSO setup, with some additional metadata required.
- Auto-ACK: yes — portal = immediate system ACK; email = auto-ACK only if the attachment and required fields parse successfully (otherwise we send an exception email to the submitting address).

I attached a minimal invoice skeleton (CSV) we prefer for email ingestion and listed the mandatory fields below so your ERP export can map cleanly:
- vendor_name (string)
- vendor_tax_id (string) — optional if you already provided W-9, but recommended
- invoice_number (string)
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- due_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- po_number (string) — must match Redwood PO (PO stamping is fine)
- line_description (string)
- quantity (numeric)
- unit_price (decimal)
- currency (ISO 4217)
- total_amount (decimal)

Practicals: for email fallback please set the subject line to: "Redwood Invoice: {PO_NUMBER} - {INVOICE_NUMBER}" so our parser routes correctly. If the CSV fails to parse, we mark it as "manual processing required" and CC your accounts alias with next steps.

I'll loop Marissa for the PO mapping and Connor for the portal onboarding timers.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: invoice_skeleton_v1.csv (CSV, 1KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, Elena Morales <elena@brightline.io>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission question

Elena / team — adding a few practical constraints from the AP side:

- PO matching: our system requires an exact match on PO number string (no whitespace differences). If Brightline stamps POs in their invoice PDF but the CSV line PO is missing, that will force manual match and delay payment. Please include the PO in the CSV.
- Line granularity: you can aggregate to a single invoice-level line (one total_amount) but please include at least one line_description and quantity=1, unit_price=total_amount so our ledger aligns.
- Tax handling: if taxes are separate lines in your ERP, either include them as separate line items with distinct line_description (e.g., "Sales Tax") or include taxes in total_amount and set tax_indicator=INCLUDED.

ACK specifics: when an email is accepted by parser we send an automated email back to the submitting address within ~5 minutes. If parsing fails we send an automated rejection with the parsing error and a link to self-service upload.

Example subject for auto-route: RedwoodInvoice|PO:{PO_NUMBER}|INV:{INVOICE_NUMBER} — we can map either the pipe-delimited or the plain form above.

Marissa Cole
Sr. AP Operations
Redwood Inference

Elena — quick implementation notes from Portal team so you know timelines:

- SSO invite (Okta) expected to go out by 2027-04-12. Until the invite is accepted we recommend using the email fallback.
- Email parser: we support both multi-row (one row per line) and aggregated single-line invoice CSVs. For multi-row, include an invoice_row_id (optional) to help de-dupe.
- ACK payload: we can include a small parse-summary attachment (parse_summary.txt) with key fields (invoice_number, total_amount, matched_PO, parse_status). We do not attach raw parsed JSON to ACKs for security reasons, but can share via a secure SFTP drop or HubSpot record if needed.

Next steps: Elena, if you send the sample CSV redline you mentioned, we'll validate it against invoice_skeleton_v1.csv and confirm mapping. I'll also open a HubSpot task (BR-4421) to track the SSO + fallback window.

Connor O'Brien
Portal Product Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: parse_summary_example.txt (TXT, 512B)
